response.sql: WITH r AS (SELECT d.A3 AS region, AVG(t.amount) AS avg_amt, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM trans t JOIN account a ON a.account_id = t.account_id JOIN district d ON d.district_id = a.district_id GROUP BY d.A3), m AS (SELECT AVG(avg_amt) AS mean_avg FROM r) SELECT AVG(r.avg_amt) AS mean_of_avg_amounts, AVG(r.cnt) AS mean_of_txn_counts, AVG(r.avg_amt - m.mean_avg) AS mean_excess_over_cross_region_mean FROM r CROSS JOIN m WHERE r.avg_amt > m.mean_avg;

assumptions.assumption: The cross-region mean is the unweighted mean of the regional average amounts, with each region counted once. It is not the overall transaction-level average.
The inner joins from trans to account to district exclude regions that have no transactions. Every transaction has an account and every account has a district, so none are dropped.
